The '''Paint Drying Simulator''' is a {{Rare}} item.

== Obtaining ==
A '''Paint Drying Simulator''' can be obtained as a Minor Reward during [[Raffle of the Century]] event, or from the {{Item|Gift Bag of the Century}}.
== Usage ==
A {{Item|Paint Drying Simulator}} can be used to obtain a cumulative {{Stat|Carpentry Wisdom|3.5}} after watching seven colors of paint dry. Each color grants {{Stat|Carpentry Wisdom|0.5}}; each colored tile, displayed with an enchanted stained glass pane, will take between {{Green|500}} and {{Green|2,500}} seconds to fully dry (between {{Green|8.3}} - {{Green|41.7}} minutes), after which it will lose its enchantment glint.

{{/UI}}
